item.content:encoded:
Kayla Nicole is encouraging women to rediscover themselves after heartbreak, but her latest relationship advice has also brought her past with
Travis Kelce
back into the conversation. The influencer recently answered a fan's question about getting over a breakup, offering practical suggestions centred on self-care, fitness, personal growth and family. Her advice arrives months after her former boyfriend Kelce married pop superstar
Taylor Swift
in July 2026. While Kayla did not mention the NFL star or his marriage, her latest message has attracted attention because of their highly publicised relationship history.
Kayla Nicole shares five tips for getting over a breakup
Kayla recently used Instagram's question-and-answer feature to respond to someone seeking advice on moving forward after a relationship ends. Rather than focusing on finding another partner, she encouraged people to invest their energy in themselves and build a fulfilling life outside romantic relationships.
Her recommendations included everything from a fresh hairstyle and a relaxing massage to spending time at the gym and discovering new interests.
She shared the following advice:
" -pour into yourself (treat yourself to a new hairstyle, nails done, massage.) Give yourself the love you desire from others.
-get in the gym and give your mind/body 1-2 hours of dedicated time to solely think about YOU
-find a new hobby to help pass the time you're spending alone
-volunteer in your community (pouring into others can help center you and remind you of the love that you're still capable of giving).
Puts a lot into perspective.
-Prioritize time with friends and family. Romantic love isn't the only love in this life that holds weight"
Her final point stood out. Kayla reminded her followers that romantic relationships are only one part of life and that friendships and family connections deserve equal attention.
However, her advice also attracted sarcastic commentary from a parody account on social media. The account mocked her repeated breakup advice and brought up her past associations, including references to Diddy parties, Joey and her 'Dear Black Girl' letters. It also made a sarcastic remark about her mingling with Rick Ross. These were comments from the parody account, not statements made by Kayla.
Travis Kelce's marriage to Taylor Swift brings renewed attention to Kayla Nicole
Kayla's relationship history with Travis Kelce remains a major reason her personal life attracts attention. The two reportedly dated on and off for several years before going their separate ways in 2022.
Kelce has since moved forward with Taylor Swift. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end married the Grammy-winning singer in July 2026, marking a new chapter in his personal life.
Although Kayla has not connected her latest Instagram advice to her former relationship, the timing has renewed online interest in her past with the NFL star.
For now, her message focuses on something broader than any celebrity breakup: learning to value yourself, finding happiness outside romance and recognising that love comes in many forms.
